messages:
Sam P.: heads up — late add: Marta Alvarez (Madrid) can't do in-person I-9 tomorrow, has a Power of Attorney notarized. Need ops sign-off + same-day laptop ship. thoughts?
Emma (People Ops): do we have the POA docs already? PDF? notarized apostille?
Marta Alvarez: uploaded POA here: https://files.redwood-secure/example-upload/abcd1234 (password sent via 1:1). it's notarized by a Madrid notary, has apostille.
Emma (People Ops): OK I see the upload. need to verify ID match and that POA covers employment verification. i'll confirm with legal. ETA ~1h.
Jordan (IT): we can do same-day ship if we get approval by 11:00am PT. DOA laptop image ready. shipping hold code: `POA-HOLD`.
Sam P.: @Jordan (IT) great. please hold image until we get greenlight. if legal says yes we release to courier.
BG-Check Bot: background-check: order submitted for Marta Alvarez. Vendor: ClearCheckEU. Estimated complete: 24-48h. status: pending-identity-verify.
Marta Alvarez: background vendor sent a request for alternate ID verification; i replied with national ID + selfie.
Emma (People Ops): legal confirmed — POA covers I-9 type actions, provided apostille present and signed. We need two things: 1) copy of front/back of passport/national ID, 2) courier witness signature at pickup to attest POA transfer.
Sam P.: noted. @Rita - Courier can courier team witness signature be arranged?
Rita - Courier: yes we can do a witnessed pickup. pickup window 2pm-4pm CET (5am-7am PT). courier requires a pickup authorization email and the POA PDF printed.
Jordan (IT): send laptop to Rita's route. shipping label: `RW-EXP-1776`. I'll attach manifest to the ticket. Also will include MFA token setup instructions in the box.
Emma (People Ops): i'll prep pickup authorization email and PDF print instructions. i'll also flag payroll onboarding to accept POA for I-9 provisioning.
Marta Alvarez: quick Q — will courier sign the I-9 on my behalf or just witness?
Emma (People Ops): courier will witness the POA transfer but cannot sign employer section. With POA, our rep (sam or emma) will sign employer portion after we verify docs. We'll record witness statement and attach to HR file.
Sam P.: action items: (1) Emma — send courier auth + print instructions (by 10:30am PT). (2) Jordan — hold laptop, prepare label and manifest (by 11:00am PT). (3) Marta — complete vendor selfie + confirm pickup time window (now). (4) Rita — confirm pickup slot and that witness will sign chain-of-custody form.
Rita - Courier: slot confirmed: 5:30am PT pickup. courier will sign chain-of-custody and take photo of POA and pickup person (consent form signed).
BG-Check Bot: background-check: identity documents uploaded by candidate. status: in-review by ClearCheckEU.
Jordan (IT): label and manifest attached to ticket #IT-6723. holding release code `POA-OK`.
Emma (People Ops): legal already asked for scanned witness statement template — i'll fill and sign employer attestation once courier confirms pickup and we have scanned POA.
Sam P.: sounds good. Marta, can you confirm someone at your address will be there 5:30am PT?
Marta Alvarez: yes that's fine — neighbour will hand documents. i've shared their name: Carlos Ruiz.
Emma (People Ops): please also confirm that neighbour will show matching ID and will sign chain-of-custody.
Marta Alvarez: confirmed. neighbor ID: DNI 12.345.678Z. will sign.
Sam P.: once procurement of laptop is confirmed, we'll create a short video call to verify employer signature remotely and record for the file.
Rita - Courier: pickup complete — photo uploaded to secure courier portal, chain-of-custody signed by Carlos Ruiz. POA scanned and uploaded. pickup_ts: 1765441800.
BG-Check Bot: background-check: vendor completed identity match. status: cleared-subject-to-records (criminal check pending).
Emma (People Ops): received POA scan and courier photos. legal reviewed and OK'd. Emma signed employer attestation and uploaded to HR file.
Jordan (IT): release code `POA-OK` used, laptop dispatched same-day via overnight. tracking: https://courier.example/track/RW-EXP-1776. ETA 1 business day.
Marta Alvarez: thanks everyone! will confirm receipt and complete onboarding call after i get laptop.
Sam P.: thanks team — closing loop. will post a short summary to the onboarding doc and add attachments (POA, courier photos, attestation, BG vendor notes). :thumbsup:
